description: Import a public Hugging Face model that contains a pre-built ONNX file. EdgeGate downloads the file and registers it as an Artifact. Returns the artifact_id you can pass directly to edgegate_create_pipeline. Polls until the import completes by default (poll_for_completion=true); set to false to return immediately with the job id.
name: edgegate_import_huggingface_model
